title: Lawsuit challenges US rule ending duration of status
summary_en: A coalition of cross-sector bodies have filed a lawsuit against the US government’s new visa restrictions, seeking “stability and protections” for international students and scholars.
author: Polly Nash
title_cn: Lawsuit challenges US rule ending duration of status

title: Judge dismisses Trump’s Harvard antisemitism lawsuit
summary_en: A US federal judge has dismissed a Trump administration lawsuit alleging antisemitism and discrimination against Jewish and Israeli students at Harvard University.
author: Polly Nash
title_cn: Judge dismisses Trump’s Harvard antisemitism lawsuit

title: CBSA checks end international student PGWP protest in Canada
summary_en: Indian graduates say they were led to believe their non-credit courses qualified for post-study work permits, while 12 attendees at the 22-day Calgary protest have been flagged as “possibly inadmissible”.
author: Abhishek Nair
title_cn: CBSA checks end international student PGWP protest in Canada

title: US Senators call for faster study visa processing
summary_en: Thirty US Senators have called on Secretary of State Marco Rubio to expedite visa processing for international students and scholars in time for the start of the academic year.
author: Polly Nash
title_cn: US Senators call for faster study visa processing

title: UNESCO convention opens path to degree recognition and mobility among Arab states
summary_en: Five countries are initially bound by the agreement, which sets common rules for recognising higher education qualifications and supporting mobility across the region.
author: Abhishek Nair
title_cn: UNESCO convention opens path to degree recognition and mobility among Arab states

title: Clare rejects Hanson’s “farce” claim as he defends international education reforms
summary_en: Australia’s education minister Jason Clare has rejected Pauline Hanson’s claim that Australia’s international education sector is a “farce”, while acknowledging that “shonks” and “dodgy providers” continue to threaten the sector’s reputation.
author: Kim Martin
title_cn: Clare rejects Hanson’s “farce” claim as he defends international education reforms
